content.prompt: Complete the ThreeButtonComponent class to draw three boxes that look like push buttons. Each box is a Rectangle drawn in Color.GRAY using the Graphics2D method fill3DRect. Look in the Graphics2D class API for a complete description of this method. Use true for the value for the boolean raised parameter. (We will learn more about the boolean data type in Chapter 4.) The center of each box has a different colored circle, Color.RED, Color.GREEN, or Color.CYAN.
